description: This file defines request handlers for device management operations such as listing, approving, rejecting, removing devices, and rotating or revoking device tokens within a gateway server context.

methods.name: redactPairedDevice
methods.description: Redacts sensitive information from a device object, summarizing tokens.

methods.name: logDeviceTokenRotationDenied
methods.description: Logs a warning message when device token rotation is denied, including reason and scope.

methods.name: loadDeviceTokenRotateTarget
methods.description: Loads and validates the device and role for token rotation, returning null if invalid.

methods.name: resolveDeviceManagementAuthz
methods.description: Resolves the authorization context for device management based on client connection scopes and device ID.

methods.name: deniesCrossDeviceManagement
methods.description: Checks if the client is authorized to manage the target device, denying cross-device management unless admin.
